newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pacific mandates HK$3.5 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pacific mandates HK$3.5 bln loan.

text.p: CITIC Pacific has mandated Chase Manhattan Asia, HSBC Investment Bank Asia and J.P. Morgan Securities Asia to arrange a HK$3.5 billion equivalent term loan facility, the arrangers said.
The facility is comprised of two tranches.
Tranche A of HK$2.720 billion will be available in both Hong Kong and U.S. dollars and has a final maturity of seven years with a put option at the fifth anniversary.
Tranche B of US$100 million will be available in U.S. dollars only and will have a final maturity of seven years.

Tranche A pays an interest margin of 60 basis points per annum from year one to five and 70 basis points from year six to seven, while tranche B carries an interest margin of 67.5 basis points throughout the life of the facility.
Proceeds of the facility will be used for general corporate requirements of CITIC Pacific.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia and J.P. Morgan Securities are bookrunners for the deal. Chase Manhattan Asia will serve as facility agent and will be responsible for documentation and publicity.
